description: Find readers to mention: the accounts whose repos hold a book record (a Livtet review or shelving row, a Bookhive book, or a Popfeed review or shelf item), matched by handle prefix or display name. Only accounts whose handle the index knows are answered — a mention is typed as a handle, so a row without one cannot be named.

q.description: What the reader typed after `@`: a handle prefix, or part of a display name.

limit.description: How many accounts to answer. A picker asks for a handful, not a page.

did.description: The account to mention. This is what a mention record stores.

handle.description: The handle the linked repo registered under, and the text a mention shows.

displayName.description: The name in the reader's own profile record, when the index has one.
